welcome.title: Edit videos by chatting.
welcome.body: Trim clips, add captions, generate images, or create new scenes—all from chat.

referral.title: How did you hear about us?
referral.body: Pick as many as apply — it tells us where to show up next.

modes.title: Works in the cloud or on your Mac
modes.subtitle: Same editor. Choose what works for you.
modes.switching: Automatically switches between cloud and local when available.

aiChat.title: Chat with your editor.
aiChat.body: The AI has access to your entire project. Ask it to trim clips, generate missing shots, write subtitles, add voiceovers, rearrange your timeline, or answer questions about your footage.
aiChat.models: Works out of the box with Gemini, or use your own Claude or Codex subscription.

credits.body: Already in your account — nothing to claim. Spend them on generated video, audio and images.

phoneGate.title: Donkey Cut runs on a computer
phoneGate.body: Open donkeycut.com on your Mac or PC.

plans.title: Simple pricing
plans.subtitle: The editor is free. Pay only for AI generated media and storage.
plans.paywallSubtitle: Pick a plan to start. You edit on a computer: sign in there with this account.
plans.covers: {months, plural, one {For your first month, then {price}/month} other {Per month for your first # months, then {price}/month}}

clip.title: Select a clip
clip.body: Click a clip on the timeline. Its settings open beside the preview.

media.title: Open Media
media.body: Files you import land here. Drag one onto the timeline to use it.

chat.title: Ask the assistant
chat.body: Press Enter to send it. The assistant edits the project for you.
chat.prompt: Make the August Recap title bigger

tour.locked: Finish the tour to start your own project
tour.backLocked: Finish the tour to leave this project
